text.title: Fashion Day at our school
text.meta: School Magazine · Laylo talks to Ali
paragraphs: It’s Fashion Day at School Number 5 in Tashkent! Everybody is wearing colourful clothes. Our reporter Laylo talks to Ali, 12, from Class 6B.
Laylo: Hi, Ali! I love your clothes. What are you wearing today? Is that a new jacket?
Ali: Thanks, Laylo! I’m wearing this green **jacket** and these blue **jeans**. This jacket is from my grandma. It’s warm and soft. I’ve got a new **T-shirt**, too. It’s orange, my favourite colour!
Laylo: Cool! Now look at those **shoes** by the door. Which shoes are yours? The white ones or the black ones?

Ali: The white ones! The black ones are my brother’s. They’re too big for me. Oh, and look at that red **cap**! That’s Bobur’s. And those purple **socks** are Madina’s. She loves purple. Fashion Day is really fun!

tf: Ali’s jacket is from his grandma.

mcq.q: What is wrong with the black shoes?
